description_en: Queries the configuration of an access control policy group
description_zh: 查询访问控制策略组的配置
kebab_example: aliyun slb describe-access-control-list-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --acl-id acl-bp1ut10zzvh1y8dfs0000 --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAccessControlListAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the access control policy group.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27584.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略组的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27584.html接口查询地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the access control policy group to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的访问控制策略组ID
parameters.name: acl_id

parameters.help_en: The description of the entries in the access control policy group
parameters.help_zh: 访问控制策略组的条目的备注信息
parameters.name: acl_entry_comment

parameters.help_en: The page number for the paged query
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in the paged query. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数。最大值：50。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

AclEntry.description_en: The list of entries in the access control policy group
AclEntry.description_zh: 访问控制策略组的信息列表

AclEntryComment.description_en: The description of the access control entry
AclEntryComment.example: The remarks of the ACL entry.

AclEntryIP.description_en: The IP address of the access control entry

AclId.description_en: The ID of the access control policy group

AclName.description_en: The name of the access control policy group

AddressIPVersion.description_en: The IP type of the associated instance

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the access control policy was created. The time is in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format
CreateTime.description_zh: 访问控制策略的创建时间，格式为：`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`

RelatedListener.description_en: The list of listeners associated with the access control policy group
RelatedListener.description_zh: 该访问控制策略组已绑定的监听列表

items.description_en: The list of listeners associated with the access control policy group
items.description_zh: 该访问控制策略组已绑定的监听列表

AclType.description_en:
The type of access control. Valid values:

black: blacklist.

white: whitelist
AclType.description_zh:
访问控制的类型：

black：黑名单

white：白名单

ListenerPort.description_en: The frontend port of the associated listener
ListenerPort.description_zh: 绑定的监听的前端端口

LoadBalancerId.description_en: The ID of the Classic Load Balancer (Server Load Balancer) SLB instance
LoadBalancerId.description_zh: 传统型负载均衡实例的ID

Protocol.description_en: The protocol type of the associated listener
Protocol.description_zh: 绑定的监听的协议类型

TagKey.description_en: The tag key of the ACL

TagValue.description_en: The tag value of the ACL

TotalAclEntry.description_en: The total number of access control entries
